text:
Nora: Quick sync  small pricing experiment for the plans page before the May 4 webinar. goal = cut cognitive load and route higher intent signups to sales.
Jamie: what are we changing exactly?
Nora: replacement of the dense tariff table with a compact 3-column matrix + micro-FAQ + a lightweight estimator. aim is clearer per-unit messaging and faster CTAs.
Diego: experiment hypothesis = reduced friction -> higher demo clicks from mid-market and more MQLs. recommend segmenting visitors by company-size dropdown.
Alisha: agree. we'll need clear tracking for each funnel step. propose events: `estimate_open`, `estimate_run`, `estimate_submit`, and `plan_cta_click`.
Jamie: estimator variants?
Nora: two routes: Variant A = inline quick-quote (tokens/month input, concurrency select) that shows a rounded monthly estimate and suggested plan; Variant B = modal "Quick quote" that asks 2 questions and emails estimate with link. both client-only.
Diego: keep it client-side to avoid backend queueing. snippet example: `const monthly = Math.round(tokens * pricePerToken * 100) / 100;` very approximate.
Alisha: analytics: also capture `company_size` and `utm_experiment=plan_minifeature_may` on form submits. tie to HubSpot via hidden fields `experiment=plan_viz_Apr2026` and `lead_route=webinar-sales`.
SalesBot: FYI I can auto-create HS deal when `lead_score>=60` and tag `experiment=plan_viz_Apr2026`. confirm threshold?
Nora: 60 is fine for this test. SalesOps: please confirm later.
Keiko: legal check  confirm no PII captured by the estimator; if modal collects email we need a short privacy notice.
Jamie: modal version will request email; inline variant will not persist data. we'll add the notice and checkbox for modal.
Diego: routing logic  funnel: modal/email -> nurture sequence + sales-notify if lead_score>=60; inline CTA -> open demo form with hidden fields. sales notification to #sales-leads with `experiment=plan_viz_Apr2026` in the message.
Alisha: A/B metrics: primary = demo request rate per 1k visitors; secondary = MQL conversion rate, trial starts, and revenue-weighted lead count. split by region US/EU.
Jamie: accessibility: ensure modal traps focus, sliders keyboard-friendly, labels for inputs.
Nora: micro-FAQ (collapsed) suggestions: 1) "How are tokens billed?" 2) "How do reserved instances work?" 3) "Can we run in our VPC?" 4) "How do I get enterprise support?" keep answers one-line + "learn more" links.
Diego: rollout plan: copy freeze Tue noon, dev Wed-Thu, QA Fri, soft launch Saturday AM to 10% traffic, full roll Monday AM if no regression. webinar Mon evening.
Alisha: tagging: add `experiment_tag=plan_minifeature_may` to all form submissions and create a GA cohort for experiment visitors. set a dashboard with funnels and revenue-weighted leads.
Keiko: approve copy for privacy blurb by Wed morning.
Nora: ACTIONS: Nora finalize microcopy (today), Jamie build inline estimator (Wed), Diego implement modal and routing (Thu), Alisha wire analytics and HubSpot mapping, SalesBot to confirm auto-task creation at threshold 60, Keiko approve notice.
SalesBot: smoke test: when form contains `experiment=plan_viz_Apr2026` then post to #sales-leads and create hs_task for `lead_score>=60`. will report back.
Nora: Thanks team  if no objections i'll push copy to staging tonight. :rocket:
